column1: # ported.tsv: what docs/history/carried.py holds the removals' deletions to, beyond the imports.
# Columns (tab-separated): side, kind, path (as the source repository names it), commits (comma-
# separated full SHAs of the source repository, or -), the commit of THIS repository that carries
#   port          upstream changed the path after the import's source (between the merge base of
#                 source and removal base, and the removal base); the commits are upstream's, and
#                 carried.py proves the tip holds every one of their changes
#   port-delete   upstream deleted a path the import holds; the tip holds it no more
#   fork-only     the import's source changed the path where upstream never did; the commits are the
#                 fork's, and the reason says why the change stands here
#   not-carried   the removal deletes a path no import projects
# carried.py fails on a row nothing needs.
